name: anilist-tracker
description: A Chrome/Edge extension that automatically detects manga, manhwa, and anime progress and syncs it to your AniList account.

scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts && node scripts/check-permissions.mjs
scripts.build:dev: vite build --mode development && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development
scripts.build:store: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../anilist-tracker-store.zip . -x "*.map"
